root_cause_and_implementation: Three narrow, targeted changes, exactly matching E040's plan and touching no other C1 domain. (1) RunInputCaptureRepository::resolveSeedRunId(int $runId): ?int (RunInputCaptureRepository.php) reads the already-existing, immutable RUN_CREATED event for a run and returns its recorded seed_run_id, or null when absent -- nothing new is written, this only reads a link EodRunRepository::createPromoteRunFromSeedWithinTransaction has always recorded. (2) ProducerInputCompletionManifest::inspect() gained an optional third parameter ($visitedRunIds = [], for cycle safety on chained repairs; run_id is monotonically increasing at creation so a true cycle is structurally impossible, but the guard costs nothing) and, after computing $missing exactly as before (zero changes to any existing check), a final reference-resolution step: if any missing path starts with provider_mapping. or source_observations. (the only two domains this touches, matched by literal prefix, nothing broader), resolve the run's seed_run_id; if present, fetch the seed run via the existing owningRun() and recursively call inspect() on it (reusing 100% of the existing, already-proven hash/population/ingress-provenance validation logic, not a parallel implementation); if the seed run's own missing_paths do not include the same provider_mapping/source_observations entries, those entries are removed from this run's $missing and the seed run's own actual_slots (plus anything it itself already resolved by further reference, walking an arbitrarily deep chain correctly) are recorded in a new referenced_components output key, each tagged source_run_id. Any failure along this path (seed_run_id absent, owningRun() throwing INPUT_CAPTURE_RUN_NOT_FOUND, the seed's own recursive inspection still reporting the domain missing) is caught and leaves $missing exactly as originally computed -- fail closed, never a silent pass. (3) PublicationInputBindingService::bind() now tags every directly-captured component with source_run_id = (int) $run->run_id (explicit even in the ordinary case, so a reader never has to infer ownership from an absent field), and additionally includes each manifest-referenced component by re-fetching the exact row from its true source run via the existing forRun() (never copying it into this run's own md_run_input_captures), re-verifying its payload_hash still matches what the manifest asserted (defense in depth against a race between inspection and bind; throws INPUT_CAPTURE_BINDING_REFERENCED_CAPTURE_UNVERIFIABLE if it does not), and tagging it with its real source_run_id. No change to deriveCompatibilityHashes or any of the seven V1 compatibility hashes -- none of them depend on provider_mapping/source_observations. Six tests in MarketDataPipelineIntegrationTest.php prove the eight required properties: test_promote_single_day_repair_candidate_completes_via_referenced_seed_run_capture (repair_candidate reaches SUCCESS/SEALED, binds V2, and every component's source_run_id is checked -- provider_mapping/source_observations point at the seed run, everything else at the derived run itself; a manual re-bind afterward proves idempotency); test_promote_single_day_incremental_completes_identically_to_repair_candidate (two sequential repair-and-correction cycles, the second using the 'incremental' spelling, both complete and each candidate's referenced components correctly point at its own distinct seed run, not the other's); test_repair_candidate_referenced_capture_is_unaffected_by_later_live_data_changes (md_provider_symbol_mappings mutated live after the seed run captured its data; the bound bundle's referenced provider_mapping payload_hash is proven byte-identical to what was captured before the mutation); test_repair_candidate_fails_closed_when_the_referenced_seed_run_cannot_prove_the_domain (three sub-proofs: direct SQL tampering of an already-written seed capture is itself rejected by the pre-existing INPUT_CAPTURE_IMMUTABLE trigger, confirmed directly rather than assumed; a bare run whose seed_run_id names a nonexistent run still reports the domain missing; a bare run whose seed_run_id names a real but capture-less run still reports the domain missing).
